sections.text:
[Effects]
Increases physical and magic Ability Power by 7XL.
Target: yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 5.
Increases damage when using a physical or magic attack Ability by M.
Applies Penetrate, which permits piercing through damage reduction and damage reflection effects when attacking.
Ability Power scales with the number of Water elemental Weapons equipped up to a max of 7XL+ (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 3).

[Activation]
When a physical or magic attack Ability is used.

[Activation Rate]
M+
Activation rate scales with the number of Water elemental Weapons equipped up to a max of XL (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 3).
